dogecoin.text: @DeanCruddace I like Elon. $TLSA is my second largest holding, but Dogecoin has run on the back of a few tweets, an appearance on SNL, FOMO and nothing else. It’s nuts.
@stefankimak By design Dogecoin will never hold its value (10,000 Doge are mined every minute with no cap on its supply). As a store of value it is useless.

There are people out there who were reluctant to invest their money into the stock market out of fear of losing it (a fair and valid concern) yet were happy to dump money into utter shit like Dogecoin without a second thought. Rekt.
